note: Route B thinned (brief 059 S1; Motive's s1-rulings route-b-thin): route-b with one posted rival taken down before the pickup where the other two cannot see it: at about 5:08 the Enforcer, waiting at the square, knocks out rival-3 at his lone post by the café terrace's west wall from behind (1.3 m off his back; he faces our car), 28 m from the pair on the square's east side, beyond their pistols' 16 m, and leaves him; then on to the service lane at 5:30 as route-b. Brief 098 (Waymark): rebuilt on route B as brief 096 has it (engine 0.42.0, the lend): the Scout listens to the driver, the Tech loops the pickup camera and the Fixer pays the driver off tape, the Scout misleads the lookout (rival-4) once he posts, the Tech reroutes the patrol, the Enforcer takes Popovic in the back seat and the Take lends Popovic's car: its Go is the win, and the three break the posted crew at our car, board and Go before the police close in. The plan it replaces tipped the rival car off at 3:10 (retired by brief 096: the car boxes ours in on arrival and the Mislead is for a man on foot) and drove our car round to the service drive at 5:53 (refused: ours is boxed in at the square from 2:53). Brief 101 (engine 0.52.0, the square's mast on the terrace's west lamp, Sky's pick B): rival-3's lone post by the café terrace is in the mast's view, so a takedown there is seen (Alert 3) and his body, left there, is found once a loop runs out (a knockout lasts 2:00, as long as a loop). So the Tech loops the mast once the pickup camera's loop has run out (planted at 4:15, live about 4:35 to 6:35), the knockout comes inside it, and the Enforcer carries him to the café's kitchen-door stash (20 m; only a stash hides a body) before going on to the service lane. He is tied first: untied, he would come round in the stash at about 7:10 and call out (the Office's staff report the noise); tied and hidden he stays out, so the rearguard at our car faces one gun fewer for good, where before he woke at about 7:08 and rejoined.
